text:
marc: Heads-up — noticed p99 TTFT on gpu-pool-eu spiking ~30% last 10m, tokens/sec steady. Grafana panel shows a right-hand tail in the token latency histogram.
anya: Can you paste the query? might be a rollup or aggregation artifact.
marc: panel: prometheus->query: sum by(pool) (rate(tokens_processed[1m])) / sum by(pool) (instances) ... added a p99(tail) calc via histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(...)))
marc: logs show a lot of long KV cache misses around the same time: "kvcache: miss=true size=24kb shard=3"
sophia: Are these the new t4p2 nodes or the older v100s? different kernel I/O patterns.
dave: It's on the new t4p2 fleet — we saw higher network egress jitter during last zone maintenance earlier.
anya: Can we correlate with NIC error counters? @sre-bot can you run `promql: increase(node_network_drops_total[5m]) by (instance)` and attach?
sre-bot: run complete — top instances: node-12: 12 drops, node-13: 9 drops, node-14: 0 drops
sophia: node-12 and node-13 colocated in eu-west-1a — could be a switch flap. Ops scheduled maintenance? 
marc: Not in calendar. For mitigation I think we should: 1) tune alert threshold for p99 -> current firing too early during small transient spikes 2) add short-term routing fallback to dedicated pool-2 3) create a heatmap panel for KV cache miss vs TTFT
anya: For (1) propose new alert: fire when p99 TTFT > 450ms for 3m AND tokens/sec > 5000. reduces noise from low-throughput anomalies.
dave: agree. For (2) can we do automated routing? we have policy 'fallback-on-high-ttft' but it's only region-wide. Need pool-level rule.
sophia: I'll open an infra change to add pool-level fallback, we can test with a synthetic load.
marc: Also suggest a histogram rollup change: use sum(rate(...[30s])) window and increase histogram buckets to reduce interpolation error for p99.
anya: Good call. Also add a small sampling of spans to trace long requests (x-request-id) so we can see KV cache path.
dave: I'll schedule a quick canary (10% traffic) to pool-2 and run the new alert query in parallel.
marc: tl;dr: tuning alert, add pool fallback, add histogram rollup, add KV-span sampling. I'll update the Grafana dashboard after ops change.
anya: :thumbsup: thanks team — let's sync if the canary shows improvement.
